params.commentary:
Suez is back. Cheaper December freight to Egypt isn't.

This week's Rockit Manifest, in five lines:

→ Evergreen's EVER EON transited Suez on 8 Nov, its first in nearly three years. The SCA lists six major lines back on Asia–Europe services.
→ Spot is softening: the Drewry WCI is down 2% to $4,305/40ft and Shanghai–Genoa is stable at $4,168.
→ But filed rates are going up. CMA CGM adds a PSS of $1,600/40ft to the Med from 25 Nov, and MSC's East Med FAK rises $800 to $6,500/40ft from 1 Dec.
→ MD1 is back on Suez with calls at Sokhna and Damietta.
→ The CBE raised rates 100bp (deposit rate 20.0%), so carrying stock costs more in Q1.

Our read: book December cargo before 25 November, and send documents with the pre-alert so the customs declaration can be lodged before the delivery order (Decree 262/2026).

The full issue, with every figure linked to its source:
https://www.rockit-transport.com/post/rockit-manifest-001-suez-december-rates
